missing_spec_content.spec_text: Students should be able to distinguish between specific heat capacity and specific latent heat.
missing_spec_content.why: No key point content explains the difference. Specific heat capacity appears only in passing: keyPoints[2].memTip "E = mL for changes of state. Q = mcΔT for temperature changes.", a checkpoint feedback line (checkpoints[1].wrongFeedback "Raising the temperature by 1 °C is specific heat capacity.") and revisionCardBullets "Heating curve: slopes = temperature change (Q = mcΔT). Flats = change of state (E = mL)". The lesson never states side by side that specific heat capacity is the energy to raise 1 kg by 1 °C (temperature changes, no change of state), while specific latent heat is the energy to change the state of 1 kg (no temperature change).
